newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-HOUGHTON BLASTS UNBEATEN 129 FROM 99 BALLS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-HOUGHTON BLASTS UNBEATEN 129 FROM 99 BALLS.

text.p: Zimbabwe player-coach Dave Houghton hit a swashbuckling century on Wednesday as his side warmed up for the triangular one-day tournament against South Africa and India with an 86-run victory over North West.
The 39-year-old Houghton showed his younger team mates the way with 129 not out from just 99 balls.
Coming in with Zimbabwe tottering at 38 for three, Houghton smashed six sixes and 12 fours, lifting the score to 260 for eight.
He and John Rennie put on 101 in 15 overs in an unbroken ninth wicket stand. Rennie made 29.
After reaching his century off 88 balls, Houghton lashed 26 runs from the final 11 deliveries he faced.
North West never came to terms with Zimbabwe's tight bowling and brilliant fielding, finishing their 50 overs on 174 for eight.
Zimbabwe play their first match of the triangular tournament against South Africa at Centurion Park on Saturday.
